exposure: Ultrasound-guided bilateral posterior transversus abdominis plane block (US-BPTAB)
outcome: Total analgesic requirement in the first 24 hours
cohort: 60 mothers scheduled for cesarean sections under spinal anesthesia
finding: The study found that US-BPTAB was associated with significantly lower post-operative pain intensity, lower total tramadol consumption, and longer duration of analgesia compared to US-BRSB.
